tests.title: The go.mod module manifest pins the official Anthropic SDK dependency
given: the repository root containing go.mod
tests.when: go.mod dependencies are parsed
then: github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go is listed as a direct dependency with a pinned minor version
tests.pseudocode: mod = read('go.mod'); assert 'github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go' in mod; assert not 'v0.0.0-' in modVersion('github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go')

tests.title: The dependency policy allowlist authorizes the official Anthropic SDK
given: the policy test suite in internal/policy/deps_test.go
tests.when: the dependency allowlist test is executed against the direct dependencies of go.mod
then: the allowlist accepts github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go without assertion failure
tests.pseudocode: allowed = loadAllowedDeps(); assert 'github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go' in allowed; runDepsPolicyTest(t)

tests.title: The Anthropic provider delegates transport and streaming to the official SDK client
given: an Anthropic provider constructed via official SDK options
tests.when: the provider executes message creation or streaming requests
then: requests and stream decoding are dispatched using anthropic.Client primitives
custom SSE parsing and ad-hoc credential refresh logic are not invoked
tests.pseudocode: client := anthropic.NewClient(option.WithAPIKey("key")); p := anthropicprovider.NewWithClient(client); assert p.UsesSDKClient()

tests.title: Resolve accepts an isolated Env lookup map and defines Source type constants
given: an Env lookup map implementation isolating process environment variables
tests.when: Resolve is called with custom variable mappings and Source constants are inspected
then: Resolve accepts the Env interface without reading or mutating os.Environ
SourceDirect, SourceVertex, and SourceBedrock are distinct typed Source constants
tests.pseudocode: env := anthropic.MapEnv{"ANTHROPIC_API_KEY": "sk-ant-test"}; c, src, err := anthropic.Resolve(env); assert err == nil; assert src == anthropic.SourceDirect

tests.title: Resolve configures Vertex AI client with project, region, and optional base URL
given: an Env containing CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX=1, ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_PROJECT_ID=my-project, CLOUD_ML_REGION=europe-west1, and ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_BASE_URL=https://custom-proxy.internal
tests.when: anthropic.Resolve(env) is evaluated
then: it returns SourceVertex
the resolved client is configured with Vertex authentication and the custom base URL
tests.pseudocode: env := anthropic.MapEnv{"CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX": "1", "ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_PROJECT_ID": "my-proj", "CLOUD_ML_REGION": "europe-west1", "ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_BASE_URL": "https://custom-proxy.internal"}; client, src, err := anthropic.Resolve(env); assert err == nil; assert src == anthropic.SourceVertex; assert client != nil

tests.title: Resolve configures AWS Bedrock client when CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK is truthy
given: an Env containing CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK=true
tests.when: anthropic.Resolve(env) is evaluated
then: it returns SourceBedrock
the resolved client pointer is non-nil and configured for AWS Bedrock
tests.pseudocode: env := anthropic.MapEnv{"CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK": "true"}; client, src, err := anthropic.Resolve(env); assert err == nil; assert src == anthropic.SourceBedrock; assert client != nil

tests.title: Resolve configures Direct Anthropic client with API key or auth token and base URL
given: an Env containing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-api03 and ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://api.anthropic.internal
tests.when: anthropic.Resolve(env) is evaluated
then: it returns SourceDirect
the client is configured with the provided base URL and API key
tests.pseudocode: env := anthropic.MapEnv{"ANTHROPIC_API_KEY": "sk-ant-api03", "ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL": "https://api.anthropic.internal"}; client, src, err := anthropic.Resolve(env); assert err == nil; assert src == anthropic.SourceDirect; assert client != nil

tests.title: Resolve rejects with an error when neither cloud deployment is selected and credentials are missing
given: an Env with no Vertex or Bedrock flags and empty ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN
tests.when: anthropic.Resolve(env) is called
then: it returns a non-nil error stating missing credentials
the returned client pointer is nil
tests.pseudocode: env := anthropic.MapEnv{}; client, src, err := anthropic.Resolve(env); assert client == nil; assert err != nil; assert strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(err.Error()), "credentials")

tests.title: Explicit cloud off flag disables cloud deployment and falls through to direct resolution
given: an Env with CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX=0, GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT=my-project, and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-test
tests.when: anthropic.Resolve(env) is called
then: Vertex deployment is disabled despite the presence of project coordinates
it falls through to direct resolution returning SourceDirect
tests.pseudocode: env := anthropic.MapEnv{"CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX": "0", "GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT": "my-project", "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY": "sk-ant-test"}; client, src, err := anthropic.Resolve(env); assert err == nil; assert src == anthropic.SourceDirect

tests.title: Resolve offline unit tests inspect client configuration and URLs without network calls
given: synthetic Env maps for Direct, Vertex, and Bedrock configurations
tests.when: Resolve is invoked in test isolation
then: client options, URLs, and source targets are validated offline
zero HTTP network connections or outbound DNS resolutions are initiated
tests.pseudocode: for _, tc := range cases { c, src, err := anthropic.Resolve(tc.env); assert err == nil; assert tc.validateConfig(c, src) }

tests.title: Catalog is pruned of non-Claude entries and clamp.go and resolve.go are removed
given: the catalog package directory and catalog.json file
tests.when: catalog.json contents and catalog directory files are inspected
then: catalog.json contains Claude model entries and zero OpenAI or Google model entries
neither catalog/resolve.go nor catalog/clamp.go exists in the repository
tests.pseudocode: raw = read('catalog/catalog.json'); assert 'claude' in raw; assert 'gpt-' not in raw; assert 'gemini' not in raw; assert not fileExists('catalog/resolve.go'); assert not fileExists('catalog/clamp.go')

tests.title: Catalog Lookup returns model descriptor and true for known Claude model IDs
given: known Claude model IDs with and without the anthropic/ vendor prefix
tests.when: catalog.Lookup(id) is invoked
then: it returns the corresponding core.Model descriptor
the returned boolean is true
tests.pseudocode: m1, ok1 := catalog.Lookup("claude-sonnet-4-5"); assert ok1 == true; assert m1.ID == "claude-sonnet-4-5"; m2, ok2 := catalog.Lookup("anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5"); assert ok2 == true; assert m2.ID == "claude-sonnet-4-5"

tests.title: Catalog Lookup returns safe default descriptor and false for uncataloged model IDs
given: an unknown model ID such as claude-next-gen-future
tests.when: catalog.Lookup(id) is invoked
then: it returns a core.Model descriptor with ID set to claude-next-gen-future
ContextWindow is 1000000, MaxOutput is 128000, and ThinkingKind is ThinkingKindAdaptive
cost rates are zero
the returned boolean is false
tests.pseudocode: m, ok := catalog.Lookup("claude-next-gen-future"); assert ok == false; assert m.ID == "claude-next-gen-future"; assert m.ContextWindow == 1000000; assert m.MaxOutput == 128000; assert m.Cost.InputUSDPer1M == 0; assert m.Cost.OutputUSDPer1M == 0

tests.title: Catalog Lookup never fails or panics for any model ID string
given: a string generator producing arbitrary model identifier strings
tests.when: for any model ID queried against catalog.Lookup
then: catalog.Lookup returns a usable model descriptor
the call does not panic, error, or return an empty descriptor ID
tests.pseudocode: for id in genModelIDs(): m, _ := catalog.Lookup(id); assert len(m.ID) > 0; assert m.ContextWindow > 0; assert m.MaxOutput > 0

tests.title: Model pricing rates and token limits reside exclusively in the catalog package
given: the provider/anthropic codebase
tests.when: source files under provider/anthropic are scanned for model IDs and pricing constants
then: no hardcoded model identifiers, token limits, or price tables exist in provider/anthropic
model metadata is queried solely through the catalog package
tests.pseudocode: files = listFiles('provider/anthropic/*.go'); for f in files: assert not containsPricingOrHardcodedModelLimits(f)

tests.title: Core package defines Effort type with discrete levels
given: package core
tests.when: the Effort type and its constants are referenced
then: core.EffortLow equals "low"
core.EffortMedium equals "medium"
core.EffortHigh equals "high"
core.EffortXHigh equals "xhigh"
core.EffortMax equals "max"
tests.pseudocode: assert core.EffortLow == "low"; assert core.EffortMedium == "medium"; assert core.EffortHigh == "high"; assert core.EffortXHigh == "xhigh"; assert core.EffortMax == "max"

tests.title: Request encoder emits adaptive thinking with effort level and omits budget tokens
given: a request for a model with adaptive thinking configured with core.EffortHigh
tests.when: anthropic.BuildRequest encodes the wire payload
then: the JSON payload contains "thinking": {"type": "adaptive"}
the JSON payload contains "output_config": {"effort": "high"}
"budget_tokens" is omitted from the thinking object
tests.pseudocode: req := core.Request{Model: "claude-sonnet-4-5", Effort: core.EffortHigh}; wire := anthropic.BuildRequest(req); assert wire["thinking"]["type"] == "adaptive"; assert wire["output_config"]["effort"] == "high"; assert "budget_tokens" not in wire["thinking"]

tests.title: Request encoder emits legacy budget tokens and omits output_config effort for budget models
given: a request for a model configured with legacy budget thinking and a budget of 4096 tokens
tests.when: anthropic.BuildRequest encodes the wire payload
then: the JSON payload contains "thinking": {"type": "enabled", "budget_tokens": 4096}
"output_config" does not specify an effort level
tests.pseudocode: req := core.Request{Model: "claude-legacy-3", ThinkingBudget: 4096}; wire := anthropic.BuildRequest(req); assert wire["thinking"]["budget_tokens"] == 4096; assert "effort" not in wire["output_config"]

tests.title: Request encoder omits thinking parameters without mutating request when effort is unsupported
given: a request targeting a model whose catalog entry indicates no reasoning effort support
tests.when: anthropic.BuildRequest encodes the wire payload
then: neither "thinking" nor "output_config.effort" is present in the serialized payload
the input request object remains unmodified
tests.pseudocode: req := core.Request{Model: "claude-no-thinking"}; wire := anthropic.BuildRequest(req); assert "thinking" not in wire; assert "output_config" not in wire

tests.title: Tool encoder emits strict true on every tool definition
given: a tool list containing multiple tools
tests.when: anthropic.BuildRequest serializes the tools into the wire representation
then: every tool object in the tools array contains "strict": true
tests.pseudocode: tools := []core.Tool{{Name: "search", InputSchema: schema1}, {Name: "edit", InputSchema: schema2}}; wire := anthropic.BuildRequest(core.Request{Tools: tools}); for t in wire["tools"]: assert t["strict"] == true

tests.title: Tool encoder strips OutputSchema, ReachableTools, and Terminating from wire tool definitions
given: tools configured with OutputSchema, ReachableTools, and Terminating properties
tests.when: the tool definitions are projected to Anthropic wire JSON
then: none of OutputSchema, ReachableTools, or Terminating (or their snake_case variants) appear in the serialized tool definitions
tests.pseudocode: t := core.Tool{Name: "test", OutputSchema: s, ReachableTools: []string{"sub"}, Terminating: true}; wire := anthropic.BuildRequest(core.Request{Tools: []core.Tool{t}}); toolJSON := toJSON(wire["tools"][0]); assert "OutputSchema" not in toolJSON; assert "output_schema" not in toolJSON; assert "ReachableTools" not in toolJSON; assert "terminating" not in toolJSON

tests.title: Request encoder omits forced tool choice and emits auto or omits tool_choice
given: requests configured with default, forced, or auto tool choices
tests.when: anthropic.BuildRequest serializes the wire tool choice
then: no forced tool choice such as "any" or a named tool lock is emitted on the wire
tool_choice is either omitted or set to {"type": "auto"}
tests.pseudocode: wire := anthropic.BuildRequest(core.Request{ToolChoice: core.ToolChoiceAny}); assert wire["tool_choice"] == nil || wire["tool_choice"]["type"] == "auto"

tests.title: Message encoder preserves raw JSON argument bytes for assistant tool_use blocks
given: an assistant message with a tool_use block whose RawArguments contains specific spacing and key ordering
tests.when: the conversation history is serialized into an Anthropic wire request
then: the replayed tool_use input in the wire request matches the original raw argument bytes exactly without reformatting
tests.pseudocode: raw := json.RawMessage(`{"b": 1,  "a":  2}`); msg := core.AssistantMessage{Content: core.Content{core.ToolUseBlock{ID: "call_1", Name: "tool", RawArguments: raw}}}; wire := anthropic.BuildRequest(core.Request{Messages: []core.Message{msg}}); assert string(wire["messages"][0]["content"][0]["input"]) == string(raw)

tests.title: Request encoder attaches ephemeral cache control to the last system block and last tool
given: a request with multiple system content blocks and multiple tool definitions
tests.when: the request is serialized for the Anthropic wire
then: cache_control with type ephemeral appears on the final system content block and nowhere else in system blocks
cache_control with type ephemeral appears on the final tool definition and nowhere else in tool definitions
tests.pseudocode: wire := anthropic.BuildRequest(reqWithMultipleSystemAndTools); assert wire["system"][last]["cache_control"]["type"] == "ephemeral"; assert wire["system"][0]["cache_control"] == nil; assert wire["tools"][last]["cache_control"]["type"] == "ephemeral"; assert wire["tools"][0]["cache_control"] == nil

tests.title: Request encoder attaches ephemeral cache control to the last prefix block and last user block
given: a request containing prefix messages and user conversation history with multiple blocks
tests.when: the request is serialized for the Anthropic wire
then: cache_control with type ephemeral is applied to the final content block of the prefix messages
cache_control with type ephemeral is applied to the final content block of the user message history
tests.pseudocode: wire := anthropic.BuildRequest(reqWithPrefixAndUser); assert wire["messages"][prefixLastMsg]["content"][last]["cache_control"]["type"] == "ephemeral"; assert wire["messages"][userLastMsg]["content"][last]["cache_control"]["type"] == "ephemeral"

tests.title: Response translator converts SDK message payloads into core AssistantMessage blocks
given: an Anthropic SDK Message object containing text, thinking, and tool_use blocks
tests.when: anthropic.TranslateMessage is called
then: it returns a core.AssistantMessage
content blocks are correctly mapped to core.TextBlock, core.ThinkingBlock, and core.ToolUseBlock
tests.pseudocode: sdkMsg := makeSDKMessageWithTextThinkingTool(); coreMsg := anthropic.TranslateMessage(sdkMsg); assert len(coreMsg.Content) == 3; _, ok0 := coreMsg.Content[0].(core.ThinkingBlock); assert ok0; _, ok1 := coreMsg.Content[1].(core.TextBlock); assert ok1; _, ok2 := coreMsg.Content[2].(core.ToolUseBlock); assert ok2

tests.title: Stream translator records input, output, cache read, and cache creation token usage
given: an Anthropic streaming event sequence containing message_start and message_delta with usage metadata
tests.when: the stream events are processed by the stream translator
then: the resulting core.Usage records input tokens, output tokens, cache read tokens, and cache creation tokens
the total request count is incremented
tests.pseudocode: usage := anthropic.TranslateUsage(startUsage, deltaUsage); assert usage.InputTokens == 150; assert usage.OutputTokens == 42; assert usage.CacheReadTokens == 100; assert usage.CacheCreationTokens == 50; assert usage.Requests == 1

tests.title: Stream translator event forwarding does not block provider loop on slow consumers
given: a provider stream connected to a subscriber channel that consumes events slowly
tests.when: the SDK stream yields a burst of stream events
then: the stream loop processes incoming events without deadlocking or blocking on the consumer channel buffer
tests.pseudocode: streamCh := make(chan core.StreamEvent, 1); go p.Stream(ctx, req, streamCh); time.Sleep(10*time.Millisecond); for ev := range streamCh { ... }

tests.title: Golden request test verifies Anthropic wire serialization against canonical fixture
given: the canonical test request and testdata/golden/request_anthropic.json
tests.when: golden_requests_test.go executes TestRequestGoldenAnthropic
then: the serialized HTTP request body produced by the SDK encoder matches request_anthropic.json exactly
tests.pseudocode: goldenBytes := read('testdata/golden/request_anthropic.json'); reqBytes := anthropic.EncodeCanonical(canonicalRequest(t)); assert bytes.Equal(reqBytes, goldenBytes)

tests.title: Golden fixture asserts exact placement of cache control annotations
given: the serialized golden request payload in testdata/golden/request_anthropic.json
tests.when: all cache_control annotations in the payload are indexed
then: cache_control appears on the final system block
cache_control appears on the final tool definition
cache_control appears on the final prefix block
cache_control appears on the final user block
no other blocks contain cache_control
tests.pseudocode: payload := parseJSON(read('testdata/golden/request_anthropic.json')); assertPayloadCacheControlPositions(payload)

tests.title: Golden fixture asserts strict true on all tools and absence of internal metadata
given: the serialized golden request payload in testdata/golden/request_anthropic.json
tests.when: all tools in the payload are inspected
then: every tool definition contains strict: true
none of OutputSchema, reachable_tools, terminating, or their camelCase variants appear anywhere in the payload
tests.pseudocode: raw := read('testdata/golden/request_anthropic.json'); assert '"strict":true' in raw; assert 'OutputSchema' not in raw; assert 'reachable_tools' not in raw; assert 'terminating' not in raw

tests.title: Golden fixture asserts adaptive thinking and output_config effort with no budget tokens
given: the serialized golden request payload in testdata/golden/request_anthropic.json
tests.when: the thinking and output configuration structures are inspected
then: "thinking" has type "adaptive"
"output_config" contains "effort"
"budget_tokens" does not appear anywhere in the payload
tests.pseudocode: payload := parseJSON(read('testdata/golden/request_anthropic.json')); assert payload.Thinking.Type == "adaptive"; assert len(payload.OutputConfig.Effort) > 0; assert 'budget_tokens' not in read('testdata/golden/request_anthropic.json')

tests.title: Golden fixture asserts byte-for-byte fidelity of replayed tool arguments
given: the serialized golden request payload in testdata/golden/request_anthropic.json
tests.when: replayed tool_use argument JSON strings are compared against the canonical input fixture
then: the argument bytes in the tool_use blocks match the input JSON bytes byte-for-byte without key reordering or whitespace alterations
tests.pseudocode: payload := parseJSON(read('testdata/golden/request_anthropic.json')); assert payload.Messages[assistantIdx].Content[toolUseIdx].InputRaw == canonicalToolUseInputRaw

tests.title: Offline environment resolution for Claude on Google Cloud Vertex AI
given: an Env configured with CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX=1, ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_PROJECT_ID=test-project, and CLOUD_ML_REGION=us-central1
tests.when: anthropic.Resolve(env) is executed
then: it resolves SourceVertex with an *anthropic.Client configured for Google Cloud Vertex AI
resolution completes offline without network requests
tests.pseudocode: env := anthropic.MapEnv{"CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX": "1", "ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_PROJECT_ID": "test-project", "CLOUD_ML_REGION": "us-central1"}; client, src, err := anthropic.Resolve(env); if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }; if src != anthropic.SourceVertex { t.Fatalf("want SourceVertex, got %v", src) }; if client == nil { t.Fatal("expected non-nil client") }

tests.title: End-to-end wire request encoding with strict tools, adaptive thinking, and prompt caching matches golden fixture
given: a canonical agent request configured with system prompt, user message, tool definition, and EffortHigh against a known Claude model
tests.when: catalog.Lookup confirms model capabilities and anthropic.BuildRequest generates the wire payload
then: the resulting JSON payload matches testdata/golden/request_anthropic.json byte-for-byte
strict tools, adaptive thinking effort, and ephemeral prompt cache breakpoints are serialized exactly
tests.pseudocode: req := canonicalRequest(t); model, ok := catalog.Lookup(req.Model); if !ok { t.Fatal("model not found") }; body, err := anthropic.BuildRequestJSON(req, model); if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }; golden, err := os.ReadFile("testdata/golden/request_anthropic.json"); if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }; if !bytes.Equal(body, golden) { t.Fatalf("golden mismatch:\n%s", diff(golden, body)) }

tests.title: Multi-turn assistant tool use replay preserves raw argument bytes end-to-end
given: an incoming assistant stream chunk with raw tool_use argument JSON bytes
tests.when: the stream translator constructs the AssistantMessage and passes the conversation history to the request encoder for the subsequent turn
then: the raw argument bytes in the outgoing wire request match the incoming argument bytes byte-for-byte
tests.pseudocode: raw := []byte(`{"path": "foo/bar.go",   "query": "func Test"}`); asstMsg := anthropic.TranslateAssistantEvent(raw); req := core.Request{Messages: []core.Message{asstMsg, core.ToolResultMessage{ToolUseID: "call_1", Content: core.Content{core.TextBlock{Text: "ok"}}}}}; out := anthropic.BuildRequestJSON(req, defaultModel); assertReplayedToolUseBytesEqual(out, raw)
